description: Open-loop scoop trajectory for the MIT-mode arm (Kp shoulder 10 / elbow 25, Kd 3, 4 N m, gravity-comp feedforward, real masses). No slip randomization, ball fixed 1.0 m dead ahead, robot and ball at rest. 97.3% success over 150 identical runs.

trajectory.units: v m/s from t=0; t_lift s; rate rad/s per joint; d_* rad above initial pose; t_brake s after t_lift; press_elbow N m feedforward before t_lift (negative = head down)
